title: Marvel's Spider-Man
summary: Peter Parker swings across open-world New York fighting classic villains.

moments.label: Harry and the Symbiote
moments.detail: Harry and the symbiote fuse completely, leading to a desperate crisis.

moments.label: Symbiote Outbreak
moments.detail: Spider-Man fights off symbiotes attacking civilians across the city.

moments.label: Clearing the Nest
moments.detail: Peter and Miles split up to clear symbiote nests and search for the meteorite.

moments.label: Hive Mind Vision
moments.detail: Peter gets sucked into the hive mind and experiences a terrifying vision.

moments.label: Subway Tunnel Battle
moments.detail: Spider-Man fights through symbiotes underground to find the meteorite location.

moments.label: Voicemail to Harry
moments.detail: Peter leaves a heartfelt voicemail trying to reach the real Harry.

moments.label: Plan at May's House
moments.detail: The team gathers at May's house to plan how to steal the meteorite.

moments.label: Facing Venom
moments.detail: Peter and Miles face Venom and his followers guarding the meteorite.

moments.label: L Cor Exploration
moments.detail: Exploration around L Cor to find a way into the underground meteorite site.

moments.label: Underground Escape
moments.detail: Spider-Man fights off symbiotes while trying to secure the meteorite rock.

moments.label: Venom Boss Fight Part 1
moments.detail: Miles and Peter confront Harry as Venom in an intense showdown.

moments.label: Rescuing Harry
moments.detail: The heroes manage to temporarily free Harry and plan to get him out safely.

moments.label: Venom Boss Fight Part 2
moments.detail: The final battle against Venom intensifies as Peter and Miles fight back.

moments.label: Ending the Threat
moments.detail: The intense struggle reaches its climax as the symbiote threat is stopped.

moments.label: The New Normal
moments.detail: MJ hosts a new podcast episode discussing the city's recovery after the crisis.

moments.label: A Visit to Harlem
moments.detail: Family moments and community events in Harlem bring warmth after the storm.

moments.label: Harry's Final Gift
moments.detail: Peter discovers a simulation and final project left behind by Harry.

moments.label: Stopping Crime Together
moments.detail: Spider-Man teams up with allies to take down street crimes in New York.

moments.label: Gas Truck Chase
moments.detail: Spider-Man stops a runaway gas truck and handles a street emergency.

moments.label: Armored Truck Robbery
moments.detail: Spider-Man interrupts a robbery and saves civilians from armed criminals.

moments.label: Protecting Civilians
moments.detail: Spider-Man steps in to protect civilians from lingering symbiote threats.

moments.label: Hunter Car Chase
moments.detail: Spider-Man pursues and stops Hunter vehicles causing trouble in the streets.

moments.label: Cultists in the City
moments.detail: Spider-Man interrupts a strange cultist gathering creating chaos in the city.

moments.label: Final Street Fight
moments.detail: A final street skirmish wraps up criminal activity across New York.
